```python
import re
from collections import Counter

def normalize(s):
    return re.sub(r'[^a-z]', '', s.lower())

anagram = "In one of the bards best thought of tragedies, our insistent hero Hamlet wonders on two fronts about whether life turns rotten"
candidate = "To be or not to be that is the question whether tis nobler in the mind to suffer the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune"

A = normalize(anagram)
B = normalize(candidate)
print("Lengths:", len(A), len(B))
print("Perfect anagram?", Counter(A) == Counter(B))
```
